notes: The evidence clearly supports recommending AIA Secure Guard Term for life protection to cover home loan and dependents, and AIA Pro Achiever Invest for education savings with critical illness and life coverage. Both products are described as suitable for closing protection gaps and building long-term wealth with insurance, matching Priya's needs and budget. The claims are well-evidenced.

citations.excerpt: This plan suits primary income earners aged 18 to 60 who want to close a protection gap for their dependents - for example, replacing 5 to 10 years of income, covering an outstanding home loan, or funding children’s education should the life assured pass away prematurely.

AIA Secure Guard Term is a regular premium term life insurance plan that provides financial protection for your loved ones in the event of death or total and permanent disability (TPD) during the policy term. It is designed for individuals who want high protection coverage at an affordable premium, without any cash val…
This is a pure protection plan. It does not accumulate cash value and has no surrender value at any point during the policy term.

Death Benefit: the higher of the sum assured or the account value is paid on death. Critical Illness Benefit: 100% of the critical illness sum assured is paid on first diagnosis of one of 105 covered critical illnesses, and the plan continues for the remaining death benefit. AIA Pro Achiever Invest is a regular premium investment-linked plan (ILP) that combines life protection, critical illness coverage, and investment in a choice of sub-funds. Part of each premium pays for insurance charges and part is invested according to the Policy Owner’s chosen fund allocation.

This plan suits individuals aged 18 to 55 who want to build long-term wealth while maintaining life and critical illness protection in a single plan, and who are comfortable with investment risk, including the possibility that fund value may fall below total premiums paid.
